About this vendor

One of the most consistent Chinese suppliers in the data set.

Shanghai-based research-grade supplier, ships internationally through standard freight forwarders. We have no commercial relationship with JinBei. Every sample on this page was bought anonymously and tested without their knowledge.

Across 20 samples of two GLP-1 / GIP analogues, the purity band stayed tight. Nine of nine Tirzepatide tests scored above 7.0. The lowest lot still cleared 98.9% HPLC purity. Endotoxin came in under pharmacy limits on all 12 samples we screened.

Buyer reports average 3.8/5 across 8 voluntary submissions. Recurring notes: clean documentation, accurate label claim, slow shipping (14–21 days to a US address).

Notes & caveats

What this rating does, and doesn't, mean.

Grade A means: across every sample we tested, the supplier cleared our purity floor and identity was confirmed. It is not an endorsement of legality, sourcing, or any health claim. Peptide therapeutics are research-use-only in the United States.

We test what arrives in the mailbox. We cannot speak to GMP compliance or what happens between Shanghai and your address. Grades can change as new samples come in.
